meta.title: Get Involved | LightLearnTech
meta.description: Volunteer, partner with or support LightLearnTech to expand educational and technological opportunities for children in Nigeria who need them most.

hero.heading: Join us in opening doors for children
hero.text: Help us expand educational and technological opportunities for children who need them most.

options.title: Volunteer
options.text: Contribute your skills, time or experience.

options.title: Partner
options.text: Collaborate with LightLearnTech to expand educational and technological opportunities.

options.title: Support
options.text: Support our work with funding, equipment (laptops, projectors, robotics kits), educational resources or other contributions.

volunteerSection.heading: Volunteer with LightLearnTech
volunteerSection.text: Teachers, tech professionals and students are all welcome. Tell us about yourself and we will be in touch.
volunteerSection.formNote: All volunteers working with children complete a background check and agree to our Safeguarding Statement.

partnerSection.heading: Partner with LightLearnTech
partnerSection.text: We welcome local and international organisations interested in funding, equipment, training or content partnerships.
